verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document linking GlitchTip issues to Jira, GitHub Issues, or Linear, and it shows no two-way status sync that resolves an error when its ticket closes or reopens the ticket on regression. The documented integrations cover other things: GitLab's Error Tracking panel and Grafana can read GlitchTip data, and alerts can go to email or a webhook. None of these is ticket linking with bidirectional sync.

support.subject: As a developer, I can link an error to Jira, GitHub Issues, or Linear with two-way status sync, so fixing the ticket resolves the error and a regression reopens it
